web_sources.title: Principles of MRI
web_sources.author: Peder E. Z. Larson
web_sources.review_scope: All 36 course contents pages; 360 heading IDs; 367 internal article links checked. Expository review, not independent verification of every equation or execution of external media/software.
web_sources.source_identity_note: Repository citation file remains v1.0/2021; live site footer 2026. Site content fingerprints and exact heading IDs are in page_manifest; repository HEAD is not proof of published build.

web_sources.title: Corsmed MRI Simulator in 6 min – Like a Real MRI Scanner on Your Laptop
web_sources.publisher: Corsmed – MRI Simulator for Colleges & Clinics
web_sources.review_scope: Complete available English auto-caption narrative, expanded description/chapter list and sampled visual checkpoints across the demonstration; not continuous frame-by-frame viewing or hands-on product testing.
web_sources.evidence_limits: Vendor demonstration; narrated breadth, accuracy and scanner-equivalence claims are not independent validation. Auto-captions contain transcription errors. No video/media/transcript mirror or stable source-content hash is claimed.
web_sources.project_use: Functionality, teaching-loop and usability candidates V01–V11 / C01–C08. Research only, not implemented controls or physics authority.
web_sources.reuse_constraints: Explicit user prohibition on copying the interface. No competitor layouts, images, assets, descriptions, exercises, patient examples or code imported.

web_sources.title: coreMRI: A high-performance, publicly available MR simulation platform on the cloud
web_sources.review_scope: Methods/architecture, source availability, competing interests and workload-dependent performance. Public service/executables do not establish a fully open-source reusable implementation.

web_sources.title: KomaMRI.jl
web_sources.review_scope: CPU/GPU backends, simulation blocks/precision/raw output, event/ADC and phantom interfaces, slice-selective example; MIT license text inspected. Not installed, executed, benchmarked or pinned. Candidate only.

web_sources.title: JEMRIS
web_sources.review_scope: Repository input concepts and GPL v2-or-later declaration/COPYING. Independent-reference candidate; not installed or integrated.

web_sources.title: BrainWeb / McGill Simulated Brain Database anatomy and tissue properties
web_sources.review_scope: Fuzzy/discrete anatomy, grid, partial volume, historical tissue parameter table, FAQ and download/citation information. No assets imported/form submitted. Product redistribution rights not established; quantitative property assignment needs explicit version/conditions.

web_sources.title: Extended phase graphs: dephasing, RF pulses, and echoes - pure and simple
web_sources.review_scope: Abstract only; EPG echo-response concept and limits. Full derivation and matched implementation validation deferred to E3.

data_source_catalog.scope: Primary-page/metadata/terms assessment with per-entry limits; discovery lists and failed sources marked. No asset-level import, approval or accepted data agreement.
